ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Hashkamas Ha'boker, Netilas Yadayim
he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּ֒שָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ עַל נְטִילַת יָדָֽיִם:
text: You, Hashem, are the Source of everything; You take care of us; and You rule the entire world; and through Your mitzvos You elevated us, and You commanded us to wash our hands (and thus make sure we put meaning and thought into all we do).
